questions.question: Summed over the twelve months of 2024, how much revenue per MW did a 4-hour battery earn at ERCOT's HB_HUBAVG?
questions.answer:
Summed over the 12 monthly rows of 2024 (Jan–Dec, local months), a 4-hour battery at ERCOT HB_HUBAVG earned the following per MW (battery_stack_monthly, derived). The answer depends on the strategy.
- Perfect-foresight strategy (an upper bound: real-time energy, day-ahead ancillary): 147,674.76 USD/MW for the year (about 147,675). Energy was 62,696.47 USD/MW and ancillary services 84,978.29 USD/MW.
- Day-ahead schedule strategy: 127,142.84 USD/MW for the year.
No days were left out in either case (sum of days_left_out is 0 for 2024). These are modeled revenues, not actual earnings. Reserves are assumed paid and never called, the battery is a price taker, and no capacity payment is included.

The load-weighted figure, which weights by demand, was 24.78 USD/MWh real-time (cost_of_power_monthly). The table covers wholesale energy only.
